episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Amanda Blakefield's life is turned upside down when she's left an enormous inheritance by a man she's neither met nor heard of before.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As Amanda digs into her past to work out the connection between her and Martin, the Worralls make things increasingly difficult for her and her family.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In the wake of a shocking murder, Amanda must consider her next move carefully. But with threats seemingly coming in from all angles, she can't risk anyone else getting hurt.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: With her mother and Jimmy both missing, Amanda's life spirals out of control. And when she finds herself being set up for murder, she must act decisively to end this once and for all.
